title: AP Inter Exam 2027 Datesheet: BIEAP 1st, 2nd year timetable released, check exam dates here
text:
• The AP Inter Exam 2027 Datesheet has been released.
• The BIEAP 1st- and 2nd-year timetable has been released.
• The 1st-year exam will commence on February 24 and end on March 15, 2027.
• The exam will begin with Elective Languages and will end with Modern Language Paper I and Geography Paper I.
• The 2nd-year exam will commence on February 25 and end on March 16, 2027.
• The exam will begin with Elective Language papers and will end with Modern Language Paper II and Geography Paper II.
• BIEAP 1st and 2nd year examinations will be held in a single shift, from 9 am to 12 noon.
• In 2026, the Class 11 theory exam commenced on February 23 and ended on March 24.
• The exam was held in a single session from 9 am to 12 noon across the state.
• The Class 12, or 2nd-year, exam commenced on February 24 and concluded on March 23, 2026.
• The exam was held in a single shift- from 9 am to 12 noon.
• The AP Inter Result was announced on April 15, 2026.
• The overall pass percentage of first year was 77% and second year was 81%.
• Minister Lokesh Nara announced the results.
• The results were announced at the press conference.
• Along with the results, the AP Inter results data, such as grade-wise results, gender-wise results, pass percentages, etc. was also released.
• For more related details, candidates can check the official website of BIEAP.
